description.value: The Penticton Public Library is a full-service community library on Main Street in the heart of Penticton, offering free public Wi-Fi, computers, printing, scanning, and a makerspace. It runs a 'Library of Things' lending program that includes outdoor exploration gear alongside tech items like Nintendo Switch consoles. For touring cyclists, it serves as a practical downtown hub for connectivity, rest, and trip planning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms free Wi-Fi through a dedicated 'Computers and Wi-Fi' navigation section, corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are explicitly mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content, so those fields remain null per the evidence-only rule. The library is operationally active — upcoming events are listed through June 2026 and a 2025 Annual Report is referenced — so the real-time 'currently closed' banner reflects hours status, not permanent closure.
concerns: Website displays a real-time 'The Library is currently closed' banner on all pages; this reflects current hours status, not permanent closure, as confirmed by active upcoming events and a 2025 Annual Report reference.
Contact page content was truncated before phone or address details appeared, so phone and address could not be verified against OSM values.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library offers free Wi-Fi and public computers useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct contact would resolve whether it meets the minimum WWC threshold.

wow_evidence: Full-service downtown library with Library of Things; ordinary library band.
blurb: Penticton's downtown library, lending outdoor gear alongside the books.
